answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. This means an attacker must choose: either run a few high-quality identities, or many worthless ones — and neither option beats honest participation.. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. Consider a copper as the anchor of the cost. A reef stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a knoll holds...
